title: Moonlight
creator: Barry Jenkins
summary: Three chapters in the life of a Black man in Miami — as a child, a teenager, an adult. A film about tenderness and what we do to it.
personalNote: Three chapters, three versions of a person. Jenkins uses light and silence like language — every frame is a deliberate choice. I've thought about the diner scene more than most things that actually happened to me. The ending is so quiet and so much.
